FM04.reasoning: The agent computes the median on X_all (which is a concatenation of train and test data) to fill missing values, leaking test set statistics into the training data.

FM05.reasoning: The dataset contains temporal components (extracted date features), but the agent uses a randomized KFold split instead of a time-based split, which can introduce look-ahead bias.

other_failure_modes.name: Test data leakage via frequency encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Frequency encoding is computed on the combined train and test dataset, leaking the test set's categorical distribution into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage in cross-validation via scaling
other_failure_modes.description: A scaler is fit on the entire training set before performing cross-validation splits, leaking validation fold statistics into the training folds and causing overly optimistic out-of-fold predictions for the Ridge model.

summary: The agent's solution exhibits multiple forms of data leakage, including imputing missing values and computing frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets, as well as scaling the training data prior to cross-validation splitting. Furthermore, the agent ignores the temporal aspect of the data by using randomized splitting instead of time-based validation.
